procedure_column: Nakanishi et al. 2022 (GCA 319) CR chondrite metal (HSE) Spot analysis fs-LA-Q-ICP-MS Tokyo Institute of Technology

Procedure Name.cell: Nakanishi et al. (2022) CR Chondrite Metal HSE fs-LA-ICP-MS Spot v1
Procedure Name.value: Nakanishi et al. (2022) CR Chondrite Metal HSE fs-LA-ICP-MS Spot v1

Laboratory.cell: Dept. of Earth and Planetary Sciences, Tokyo Institute of Technology, Japan
Laboratory.value: Dept. of Earth and Planetary Sciences, Tokyo Institute of Technology, Japan

Funding Source for Procedure Development.cell: N — the JSPS Grants-in-Aid support the study as a whole and are recorded under Funding Source for Analysis

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Nakanishi et al. (2022) GCA 319, 254; Walker et al. (2008) for IVB standards
Procedure Reference(s).value: Nakanishi et al. (2022) GCA 319, 254; Walker et al. (2008) for IVB standards

Coupling Description.cell: EPMA used to measure Ni concentration at the exact LA-ICP-MS analysis spot location, required for internal standardization of HSE data [Section 2.3]
Coupling Description.value: EPMA used to measure Ni concentration at the exact LA-ICP-MS analysis spot location, required for internal standardization of HSE data [Section 2.3]

Target Material.cell: CR chondrite metal — interior, margin and isolated metal grains (p.1); the IVB iron meteorites are the standards

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Grain > Spot — HSE abundances are reported per metal grain, each with its LA "spot No." (table p.6); the grains are typed by where they sit — interior grains in a chondrule, margin grains in its surficial shell, isolated grains in the matrix (p.1)

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Thick sections embedded in petropoxy 154 resin, the surface finalised by polishing with 0.5 µm diamond paste; carbon-coated before the EPMA measurements (§2.1–2.2). Whether the coat was removed before ablation is not stated; the later 0.5 µm polish (§2.5) preceded micromilling, not ablation
Sample Preparation Method.value: Thick sections embedded in petropoxy 154 resin, the surface finalised by polishing with 0.5 µm diamond paste; carbon-coated before the EPMA measurements (§2.1–2.2). Whether the coat was removed before ablation is not stated; the later 0.5 µm polish (§2.5) preceded micromilling, not ablation

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Picked off prior electron images — "Based on the secondary electron images taken by EPMA, we selected analytical spots for LA-ICP-MS and sampling spots for micro-milling" (p.4); the grains themselves are sorted by setting into interior, margin and isolated metal (p.1)

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: Secondary-electron imaging on the EPMA, used to place every spot — "Based on the secondary electron images taken by EPMA, we selected analytical spots for LA-ICP-MS and sampling spots for micro-milling" (p.4); the spots carry numbers ("spot No." 201, 202 …) that tie the analyses back to those images (table p.6)
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: Secondary-electron imaging on the EPMA, used to place every spot

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: Cyber Laser IFRIT (Ti:sapphire fs UV laser, 260 nm)
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: Cyber Laser IFRIT (Ti:sapphire fs UV laser, 260 nm)

Interface Cone Configuration.cell: Nickel micro-skimmer cone, Xs; nickel sampler cone — Table 1
Interface Cone Configuration.value: Nickel micro-skimmer cone, Xs; nickel sampler cone

Torch Type.cell: Quartz torch with quartz injector — Table 1

Laser Wavelength and Type.cell: 260 nm Ti:sapphire femtosecond UV; pulse duration ~220 fs (IFRIT system)
Laser Wavelength and Type.value: 260 nm Ti:sapphire femtosecond UV; pulse duration ~220 fs (IFRIT system)

Laser Spot Geometry.cell: all: 30 µm diameter — 'Each spot analysis on the sample produced a pit of 30 µm in diameter' (p.3)

Laser Spot Path / Ablation Mode.cell: all: Spot — 'ablated by a spot analysis mode' (p.3)

Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.cell: Ar, 0.6 L/min — Table 1, under 'Ar gas flow rate': 'Carrier gas 0.6 L/min'

Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate.cell: Ar, plasma gas 16 L/min; cool gas 12–13 L/min — Table 1 lists both rows under 'Ar gas flow rate'
Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate.value: Ar, plasma gas 16 L/min; cool gas 12–13 L/min

Analysis Sequence.cell: N — Warburton Range and Tawallah Valley 'were used as an external standard and a secondary standard, respectively' (p.3); the order of analyses is not described

Target Species.cell: Co, Ru, Rh, Pd, Re, Os, Ir, Pt, Au — 'The abundances of HSEs were determined with the calibration curve method by measuring isotopes of 59Co, 101Ru, 103Rh, 105Pd, 185Re, 189Os, 193Ir, 195Pt, and 197Au' (p.3). Ni is the internal standard, its concentration from EPMA

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: ⁵⁹Co → Co; ¹⁰¹Ru → Ru; ¹⁰³Rh → Rh; ¹⁰⁵Pd → Pd; ¹⁸⁵Re → Re; ¹⁸⁹Os → Os; ¹⁹³Ir → Ir; ¹⁹⁵Pt → Pt; ¹⁹⁷Au → Au; ⁶¹Ni, ²⁴Mg, ²⁹Si, ³¹P, ³³S → none — Table 1 'Measured isotopes' and 'Monitored isotopes'; ⁶¹Ni 'was monitored for internal standardization', and Mg, Si, P and S 'to check the involvement of micro-inclusions' (p.3)

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Ru, Rh, Pd, Re, Os, Ir, Pt, Au (ppm); HSE/Ir ratios; Re/Os abundance ratio — HSE abundances in metal, e.g. 'Ir abundance ranging from 1.08 to 2.53 ppm' (p.5), with major element abundances from EPMA alongside; the Re/Os abundance ratio feeds the reported 187Re/188Os, 'determined by the mean Re/Os abundance ratios for each of the 1–3 analytical spots measured by LA-ICP-MS' (Table 3, p.8)

Number of Replicates.cell: 1–3 spots per metal grain — 'the mean Re/Os abundance ratios for each of the 1–3 analytical spots' (Table 3)

Internal Standard Approach.cell: all: single element, its concentration measured by EPMA at the ablated spot — '61Ni was monitored for internal standardization. The concentration of Ni in the ablated spot was obtained by EPMA' (p.3)

value.value: single element, its concentration measured by EPMA at the ablated spot

Internal Standard Element.cell: all: Ni (⁶¹Ni) — concentration from EPMA at the ablated spot (p.3)

Elemental Fractionation Correction.cell: N — quantification is by 'the calibration curve method' against Warburton Range with ⁶¹Ni internal standardization (p.3); no fractionation correction as such is described

Uncertainty Propagation Method.cell: N — 'Analytical uncertainties accompanied with the data are 2SE of individual measurements' (p.4); how they are propagated is not described

Signal Integration Interval Method.cell: N — the paper says only that 'the intensities of individual isotopes rapidly increased to the maximum and decayed to the background level immediately after the end of ablation' (p.3)

Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.cell: N — ²⁴Mg, ²⁹Si, ³¹P and ³³S 'were simultaneously monitored to check the involvement of micro-inclusions' (p.3); what was done with an affected analysis is not stated

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: N — the signal 'decayed to the background level immediately after the end of ablation' (p.3); the background correction is not described

Interfering Species.cell: N — ²⁴Mg, ²⁹Si, ³¹P and ³³S monitor micro-inclusions, not spectral interferences

Normalization / Standards-Based Correcti.cell: N — quantification is by 'the calibration curve method' against Warburton Range (p.3)

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — the contributing counts are stated per grain, the reported ratios being "the mean Re/Os abundance ratios for each of the 1–3 analytical spots measured by LA-ICP-MS" (p.8). No acceptance or rejection rule is stated for the LA data; the 233/235 > 0.2 rejection (p.4) is a rule for the N-TIMS Os measurements, not for these spot analyses, and is not borrowed

Combination Method.cell: Re/Os abundance ratio: mean of the 1–3 spots on each metal grain; other: N — 'determined by the mean Re/Os abundance ratios for each of the 1–3 analytical spots measured by LA-ICP-MS' (Table 3)

value.value: mean of the 1–3 spots on each metal grain

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [Co, Ru, Rh, Pd, Re, Os, Ir, Pt, Au: Warburton Range (IVB iron meteorite)] — 'used as an external standard' with HSE abundances 'given by Walker et al. (2008)'; the calibration curve method (p.3)

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: Tawallah Valley (IVB iron meteorite) — 'used as ... a secondary standard' (p.3), its HSE abundances from Walker et al. (2008)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property
Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.cell: all: 2SE of individual measurements — 'Analytical uncertainties accompanied with the data are 2SE of individual measurements' (p.4)

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: N — the 2SE is stated for individual measurements (p.4), not for a standard
